name: Greta Growth Connector
author: questlabs

sections.description:
Greta Growth Connector links a WordPress site to a Greta project using a revocable, project-scoped site key.

  • Syncs published posts and pages to Greta when you run a sync or enable hourly sync.
  • Imports queued Greta articles into WordPress as drafts. It never publishes them automatically.
  • Stores the site key on your WordPress server and sends it only to Greta’s API over HTTPS.
  • Provides manual connection, sync, and draft-import actions in Settings → Greta Growth.

Create and enable the WordPress connection in your Greta project, then paste its site key in the plugin settings. Automatic sync and draft import are off until you opt in.

Learn more at Greta.sh.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP or install Greta Growth Connector from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. In Greta, create and enable a WordPress connection for the project you want to use.
  4. In WordPress, open Settings → Greta Growth and paste the site key.
  5. Check the connection, then choose whether to enable hourly sync or draft import.
sections.faq:
Does Greta publish articles directly to my website?

No. Greta articles are created as unpublished WordPress drafts. You review and publish them yourself.

Does the plugin add a Greta link to my public website?

No. It does not add public-facing credits or backlinks to your site. Greta links are shown in this plugin’s settings and documentation only.

What content is sent to Greta?

Only published posts and pages, including their title, URL, excerpt, plain-text content, and last-modified time. Drafts and private content are not synced.

Where is the site key stored?

It is stored in this WordPress site’s options and sent from the server to Greta over HTTPS. It is not exposed in page JavaScript.
